James Madison Dukes Secure Bowl Eligibility with Victory

The James Madison Dukes achieved bowl eligibility after defeating Georgia Southern 27-24. Quarterback Jordan McCloud threw for 300 yards and three touchdowns, while running back Jalen White rushed for 120 yards and one touchdown. The Dukes' defense forced three turnovers, including two interceptions by safety D'Angelo Amos. The win improved James Madison's record to 7-5 on the season, securing their spot in a bowl game.
